card.name: The "com" inside concomitant
card.fires_on: The piece "com" in the middle of the word "concomitant", after "con". It appears in drug-interaction text such as "concomitant use" or "concomitant administration".

modes.label: Concomitant use
modes.description: The "com" piece in "concomitant use" within NSAID warnings about aspirin and GI events.

modes.description: The same piece in "concomitant medications" or "concomitant administration" in interaction passages.
